name: Partial Update
description: User changes the budget for a trip but leaves destination, duration, and accommodation type unchanged.

conversation.content: I want to plan a 7-day trip to Kyoto. Budget is $2000. I'd like to stay in a traditional ryokan.
Wonderful! I'll plan a 7-day trip to Kyoto for you. Budget: $2,000. Accommodation: traditional ryokan. I'll start looking for options.
Wait, I can actually spend $3000 now. Keep everything else the same.
Great upgrade! I've updated your budget to $3,000. Your 7-day Kyoto trip with a traditional ryokan stay is otherwise unchanged.

notes: Only budget changes from 2000 to 3000. Destination, duration, and accommodation_type must remain exactly as first specified.
